body:
# Better iPhone Totem

Give your **Totem of Undying** a fresh, modern look with the **Better iPhone Totem** resource pack!

This pack replaces the vanilla Totem of Undying with a clean, smartphone-inspired design, adding a fun and stylish twist to your Minecraft adventures while keeping the item easy to recognize in-game.

## ✨ Features

* 📱 Replaces the Totem of Undying with a smartphone-inspired design
* 🎨 Clean, high-quality texture
* 🟩 Vanilla-friendly style
* ⚡ Lightweight with no performance impact
* 🌍 Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer (servers must allow resource packs)

## 📦 Compatibility

* Minecraft: Java Edition
* Works with any world
* Compatible with most resource packs that don't modify the Totem of Undying texture

## 💡 Notes

This resource pack only changes the appearance of the Totem of Undying. It does **not** affect gameplay or provide any gameplay advantages.

If you enjoy this pack, consider leaving a ❤️ favorite and a ⭐ rating. Your support helps me create more high-quality Minecraft resource packs!
